editorial_note: These are original suggested combinations, doses and form cues for generally healthy adults, informed by CDC/NHS activity principles. The publishers did not author, endorse or clinically validate these individual routines. Source fragments label local catalog entries, not publisher-owned workouts. Shared photos illustrate related activity and are not instructional demonstrations. This is a finite authored pool, not 175 promised workouts; stop at exhaustion instead of renaming routines. The opening five deliberately sample different categories, equipment, settings and levels.
safety: Start within your current ability and use a comfortable, pain-free range. Choose light resistance that leaves about 2 controlled reps available; breathe throughout, without straining. Rest a day between hard sessions for the same muscles. Stop for pain, dizziness, chest discomfort or unusual breathlessness; get medical help for concerning symptoms. Ask a qualified professional before starting if you have a condition, injury, pregnancy, recent surgery or doubts about suitability. Check equipment and keep water nearby.

cdc_activity.title: CDC: Adding Physical Activity as an Adult
cdc_activity.scope: General adult aerobic and strengthening activity, gradual participation and when to seek individual advice; not these authored prescriptions.

cdc_intensity.title: CDC: How to Measure Physical Activity Intensity
cdc_intensity.scope: General intensity guidance and conversation-based effort monitoring; not a calorie calculator or individual target.

nhs_strength.title: NHS: Strength exercises
nhs_strength.scope: Stable-chair setup, controlled bodyweight and light-resistance movements and gradual progression; not endorsement of the catalog combinations.

nhs_resistance.title: NHS: How to improve your strength and flexibility
nhs_resistance.scope: General resistance-training principles, bodyweight, bands, weights and major-muscle coverage; individual gym exercises and doses are editorial suggestions.

nhs_walking.title: NHS: Walking for health
nhs_walking.scope: Comfortable footwear, gradual walking participation and conversational brisk effort; not a clinical walking program.

nhs_warmup.title: NHS: How to warm up before exercising
nhs_warmup.scope: General gradual preparation and at least six minutes of warm-up; catalog warm-ups are independently worded adaptations, not copied routines.

nhs_cooldown.title: NHS: How to stretch after exercising
nhs_cooldown.scope: General gentle cooldown and comfortable stretching, with individual advice for health concerns; no promise of injury prevention.

warmups.upper: March gently for 3 minutes. Spend 1 minute on relaxed shoulder rolls, then 2 minutes rehearsing arm movements without resistance. Extend preparation if still stiff.
warmups.lower: Walk easily for 3 minutes. Spend 1 minute each on shallow knee bends, unloaded hip hinges and gentle heel taps, without forcing range. Use a fixed support if balance requires it.
warmups.full_body: March for 3 minutes. Use 1 minute each for shoulder rolls, comfortable shallow squats and unloaded hip hinges, gradually increasing movement.
warmups.cardio: Move easily for 3 minutes, then use 3 minutes of gentle marching, heel taps and shoulder rolls. Build pace gradually without jumping.
warmups.bike: Pedal very easily for 3 minutes, then gradually add a little resistance for 3 minutes. Check saddle height and keep a soft bend in the knee at the bottom.
warmups.row: With low resistance, row very gently for 3 minutes. Spend 3 more minutes rehearsing legs-body-arms on the drive and arms-body-legs on the return.
warmups.treadmill: Attach the safety clip and start the belt slowly. Walk easily for 3 minutes and build gradually for 3 minutes, staying at a comfortable pace.

cooldowns.upper: Walk gently for 3 minutes. For 2 minutes, relax the shoulders and use comfortable chest and upper-back stretches, holding each 15-20 seconds without bouncing.
cooldowns.lower: Walk slowly for 3 minutes. Spend 2 minutes on gentle supported calf and hamstring stretches, 15-20 seconds per side without pulling into pain.
cooldowns.full_body: Walk easily for 3 minutes. Spend 2 minutes on gentle chest, calf and hamstring stretches, holding 15-20 seconds without forcing the position.
cooldowns.cardio: Reduce speed or resistance over 3 minutes rather than stopping suddenly. Spend 2 minutes on relaxed calf and thigh stretches, supported if needed.

wall_press.name: Wall press-up
wall_press.cue: Place hands at chest height on a solid wall. Keep the body aligned, bend the elbows comfortably and press away without shrugging.

bottle_curl.name: Water-bottle biceps curl
bottle_curl.cue: Use equally filled sealed bottles. Keep elbows beside the ribs and lower slowly; do not swing the body.

wall_slide.name: Standing wall arm slide
wall_slide.cue: Stand with a relaxed back near the wall. Slide arms upward only as far as the shoulders allow without arching or pain.

band_row.name: Seated resistance-band row
band_row.cue: Use an intact band rated for foot-loop rows; secure it around the midfeet in shoes, never just the toes. Keep knees soft and draw elbows back, away from the face; release slowly. Do not use a slipping band.

band_pullapart.name: Resistance-band pull-apart
band_pullapart.cue: Hold an intact light band at chest height. Open the arms without shrugging or locking elbows, then control the return.

band_curl.name: Standing resistance-band curl
band_curl.cue: Stand securely on the intact band's middle in shoes. Keep wrists straight and elbows still; use a light band without overstretching it.

incline_push.name: Incline push-up
incline_push.cue: Place hands on a fixed counter or secured bench that cannot tip. Lower the chest with a straight body; choose a higher support if form slips.
equipment: Fixed counter or secured exercise bench

db_row.name: Supported one-arm dumbbell row
db_row.cue: Brace the free hand on a secured bench. Keep hips level, draw the elbow toward the hip and lower without twisting; complete both sides.

db_floor_press.name: Dumbbell floor press
db_floor_press.cue: Use light weights you can position safely while lying down with bent knees. Keep wrists above elbows, touch upper arms softly to the floor and press without flaring wide; set weights down under control.

db_shoulder_press.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
db_shoulder_press.cue: Sit against a stable back support. Press light weights within comfortable shoulder range; keep ribs down and avoid leaning back.
equipment: Stable backed chair or adjustable bench

lateral_raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
lateral_raise.cue: With soft elbows, raise very light weights out to the sides no higher than shoulders. Lower slowly without shrugging or swinging.

hammer_curl.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
hammer_curl.cue: Keep palms facing inward and elbows close to the ribs. Curl without swinging, then lower under control.

floor_push.name: Floor push-up
floor_push.cue: Keep head, ribs and hips aligned as the chest lowers. Use a comfortable elbow angle; stop before the back sags and switch to an incline if needed.

prone_w.name: Prone W arm raise
prone_w.cue: Lie face down with forehead resting on a folded towel. Make a W with the arms and lift them slightly without lifting the chest or craning the neck.

plank.name: Forearm plank
plank.cue: Place elbows below shoulders, brace gently and breathe. Keep hips level; lower knees if needed and finish the hold before the back sags.

db_triceps.name: Lying dumbbell triceps extension
db_triceps.cue: Lie on a mat, upper arms pointing up. Bend elbows to bring light weights beside the head, not over the face; extend without moving the upper arms.

band_press.name: Standing resistance-band chest press
band_press.cue: Pass an intact light band behind the upper back, below the neck. Press hands forward without locking elbows; keep the band secure and clear of the face.

band_external.name: Resistance-band external rotation
band_external.cue: With elbows bent and tucked beside the ribs, gently separate the hands against a light band. Keep the movement small and shoulders relaxed.

machine_chest.name: Machine chest press
machine_chest.cue: Ask staff to check the seat so handles sit near chest height. Keep the back supported, press smoothly and return without letting the stack crash.

cable_row.name: Seated cable row
cable_row.cue: Set a light load, brace the feet and sit tall. Pull toward the lower ribs without rocking, then extend arms slowly without rounding the back.

cable_curl.name: Cable biceps curl
cable_curl.cue: Face a low pulley and stand balanced. Keep elbows beside the body and curl without leaning; lower the stack gently.
equipment: Low cable pulley with curl handle

pulldown.name: Front lat pulldown
pulldown.cue: Secure thighs under the pads. Draw the handle toward the upper chest, never behind the neck; avoid swinging or pulling with the lower back.

chest_row.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
chest_row.cue: Rest the chest on a secured incline bench with feet planted. Row toward the hips without lifting the chest; lower slowly.

reverse_fly.name: Chest-supported dumbbell reverse fly
reverse_fly.cue: Support the chest on an incline bench. With very light weights and soft elbows, open arms only to shoulder level; do not shrug.

incline_db_press.name: Incline dumbbell press
incline_db_press.cue: Use a modest bench incline and light weights. Plant feet, keep wrists stacked and press without arching; use a comfortable shoulder depth.

cable_triceps.name: Cable triceps pressdown
cable_triceps.cue: Stand balanced with elbows by the ribs. Press the handle down without moving the shoulders or leaning body weight into it.
equipment: High cable pulley with pressdown handle

face_pull.name: Cable face pull
face_pull.cue: Set a light rope pulley near eye height. Pull toward the sides of the face with controlled elbows; do not jerk the cable or arch the back.
equipment: Adjustable cable pulley with rope handle

cable_press.name: Standing cable chest press
cable_press.cue: Use a light load and stable split stance with handles near chest height. Press forward with ribs down, then return slowly without twisting.

flat_db_press.name: Flat-bench dumbbell press
flat_db_press.cue: Use weights you can position and set down safely. Plant feet, keep wrists over elbows and press without bouncing or forcing shoulder depth.

sit_stand.name: Chair sit-to-stand
sit_stand.cue: Use a non-wheeled chair against a wall on a non-slip floor, with feet flat when seated. Lean slightly forward, stand through the feet and sit back slowly; use hands lightly if needed.

calf_raise.name: Supported calf raise
calf_raise.cue: Hold a fixed support lightly. Rise onto both forefeet, pause briefly and lower heels slowly without rolling ankles outward.

hip_abduction.name: Standing supported side leg lift
hip_abduction.cue: Hold a fixed support and stand tall. Lift one leg a small distance sideways with toes forward; keep the trunk still and repeat on both sides.

mini_squat.name: Supported mini-squat
mini_squat.cue: Hold a fixed support. Sit the hips back a little, bend knees comfortably in line with toes and stand without pulling on the arms.

bridge.name: Glute bridge
bridge.cue: Lie with knees bent and feet planted. Lift hips by pressing through the feet, stopping before the lower back arches; lower gently.

clam.name: Side-lying clamshell
clam.cue: Lie on one side with knees bent and heels together. Open the top knee without rolling the pelvis back; finish both sides.

step_up.name: Low step-up
step_up.cue: Use a low fixed step and handrail. Place the whole foot on top, stand through the leading leg and step down softly; complete both sides.

hip_extension.name: Standing supported hip extension
hip_extension.cue: Hold a fixed support. Move one straight leg slightly behind you without bending the trunk or arching the back; repeat on both sides.

goblet_squat.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
goblet_squat.cue: Hold a light dumbbell near the chest. Sit hips down between the feet with knees following toes; stop at a depth you control and stand steadily.

db_rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
db_rdl.cue: Soften knees and push hips back with weights close to the legs. Keep the spine steady; stop when the hamstrings limit the hinge, then stand tall.

split_squat.name: Supported split squat
split_squat.cue: Take a short split stance beside a fixed support. Bend both knees within comfortable range, keeping the front heel down; finish both sides.

single_bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single_bridge.cue: From a bridge setup, hold one foot off the floor. Lift only as far as hips stay level; lower and repeat both sides, or use two feet if needed.

side_leg.name: Side-lying straight-leg raise
side_leg.cue: Lie on one side with the lower knee bent. Lift the top leg slightly with toes facing forward; keep hips stacked and work both sides.

reverse_lunge.name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.cue: Step back with enough width for balance. Bend both knees comfortably, keep the front foot planted and push through it to return; alternate sides.

band_walk.name: Mini-band lateral walk
band_walk.cue: Place an intact light loop above the knees. Take short sideways steps with soft knees and level hips, then reverse direction; do not let knees collapse inward.

wall_sit.name: Shallow wall sit
wall_sit.cue: Rest the back against a solid wall with feet forward. Slide down only a little, keep breathing and stand before strain; do not force a right-angle squat.

single_rdl.name: Supported single-leg hip hinge
single_rdl.cue: Use a fixed support and no added weight. Hinge at the standing hip as the other leg travels back; keep hips square and repeat both sides.

single_calf.name: Supported single-leg calf raise
single_calf.cue: Hold a fixed support and lift one foot. Rise and lower slowly on the standing forefoot without rolling the ankle; work both sides.

leg_press.name: Machine leg press
leg_press.cue: Have staff check the seat and safety stops. Keep hips and back against pads, lower only within comfortable range and press without locking knees.

leg_curl.name: Seated machine leg curl
leg_curl.cue: Align knees with the machine pivot and secure pads as instructed. Curl smoothly without lifting the hips; return the stack slowly.

seated_calf.name: Seated calf raise
seated_calf.cue: Adjust the pad above the knees and place forefeet securely on the platform. Raise heels without bouncing and lower within comfortable ankle range.

leg_extension.name: Machine leg extension
leg_extension.cue: Ask staff to align the knee pivot and ankle pad. Straighten knees smoothly without snapping into lockout; keep the back supported.

cable_abduction.name: Standing cable hip abduction
cable_abduction.cue: Fit the ankle cuff and use a fixed support. With a very light load, move the leg sideways without leaning; return slowly and work both sides.
equipment: Low cable pulley with ankle cuff

db_lunge.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
db_lunge.cue: Hold light weights by the sides and step back under control. Keep a stable stance and the front heel planted; finish both sides without rushing.

hip_thrust.name: Bodyweight bench hip thrust
hip_thrust.cue: Secure the bench against movement and rest upper back on its edge. Drive through planted feet, lift hips to a straight trunk and avoid arching the back.

cable_pullthrough.name: Cable pull-through
cable_pullthrough.cue: Face away from a low rope pulley, gripping between the legs. Step clear, hinge at the hips and stand tall with a light load; do not lean back.
equipment: Low cable pulley with rope handle

lateral_lunge.name: Bodyweight lateral lunge
lateral_lunge.cue: Step sideways and sit hips toward the stepping heel. Keep both feet grounded and use a shallow range before returning; work both sides.

machine_abduction.name: Seated machine hip abduction
machine_abduction.cue: Adjust the seat and pads as instructed. Open knees slowly against a light load without rocking the torso; control the return.

walk.name: Level brisk walk
walk.cue: Choose an even, well-lit route and comfortable shoes. Walk purposefully with relaxed arms; aim for an effort where conversation is possible but singing is difficult.

march.name: Low-impact marching
march.cue: March in place with quiet steps and relaxed arm swings. Keep knee lifts comfortable and breathing conversational; reduce pace if needed.

step_touch.name: Side step-touch
step_touch.cue: Step sideways and bring the other foot alongside without jumping. Keep knees soft and steps short enough to remain balanced.

heel_dig.name: Alternating heel digs
heel_dig.cue: Tap one heel forward at a time while the supporting knee stays soft. Add small arm swings, not forceful punches or jumps.

dance.name: Easy side-step dance
dance.cue: Use a comfortable music tempo with small side and forward steps. Keep one foot grounded and turns gentle; leave room around you.

grapevine.name: Walking grapevine step
grapevine.cue: Step sideways, cross the trailing foot gently behind, step sideways again and tap. Reverse slowly; replace crossing with side steps if balance feels uncertain.

hill_walk.name: Gentle uphill walk
hill_walk.cue: Use a familiar gentle slope with secure footing. Shorten steps and keep talking comfortably; choose a milder route if you need to gasp or lean heavily.

timed_step.name: Low-platform stepping
timed_step.cue: Use a fixed low step with hand support. Step up and down without jumping, alternate the lead foot halfway through each set and keep the whole foot on the step.

stairs.name: Easy stair walking
stairs.cue: Use a clear, well-lit short flight and handrail. Walk up and down, taking extra care descending; choose one step at a time and never race.

shadowbox.name: Gentle standing shadowboxing
shadowbox.cue: Use light alternating punches below shoulder height with small walking steps. Do not lock elbows or twist sharply through planted knees; keep effort moderate.

shuffle.name: Walking lateral shuffle
shuffle.cue: Take two small side steps each way without crossing feet or jumping. Stay upright with soft knees and enough clear space to change direction safely.

bike.name: Stationary cycling
bike.cue: Set saddle height so the knee stays slightly bent at the bottom. Pedal smoothly at conversational effort; keep resistance light enough to avoid rocking the hips.

row.name: Steady rowing ergometer
row.cue: Ask staff to check foot straps and technique. Drive legs, then body, then arms; return arms, body, legs. Use low resistance and a pace that allows conversation.

treadmill_walk.name: Level treadmill walk
treadmill_walk.cue: Attach the safety clip and use a manageable belt speed. Look ahead and walk naturally; slow the belt before stepping off, never jump onto moving rails.

treadmill_incline.name: Gentle-incline treadmill walk
treadmill_incline.cue: Attach the safety clip and choose a small incline. Stay upright without hanging on the rails; reduce incline or speed to keep conversation comfortable.

dead_bug.name: Alternating dead bug
dead_bug.cue: Lie on the back with arms up and knees bent. Slowly extend opposite arm and leg only as far as the back stays still, then switch sides while breathing.

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.cue: From hands and knees, reach opposite arm and leg without tilting the hips. Keep the neck relaxed, return slowly and alternate sides.

db_deadlift.name: Dumbbell deadlift from raised blocks
db_deadlift.cue: Place light dumbbells on secure low blocks. Bend hips and knees, keep weights close and stand without rounding; use a height that permits a steady back.

farmer_carry.name: Two-dumbbell farmer carry
farmer_carry.cue: Hold light weights by the sides and walk slowly along a clear route. Stay tall, breathe and set weights down under control before grip or posture fails.

band_squat.name: Standing resistance-band squat
band_squat.cue: Stand securely on an intact long band in shoes and hold ends near the hips. Squat comfortably with knees following toes; stand without jerking the band.

pallof.name: Resistance-band anti-rotation press
pallof.cue: Use a manufacturer-rated anchor at chest height and inspect the band. Stand sideways, press hands forward without turning, return slowly and work both sides.

suitcase.name: Single-dumbbell suitcase carry
suitcase.cue: Carry a light weight on one side along a clear route. Keep shoulders level and do not lean; switch hands halfway through each timed set.

cable_pallof.name: Cable anti-rotation press
cable_pallof.cue: Set a light cable at chest height. Stand sideways and press hands away without turning the trunk; return slowly and complete both sides.

machine_shoulder.name: Machine shoulder press
machine_shoulder.cue: Have staff check the seat and start position. Press with the back supported and ribs down, staying inside a comfortable shoulder range.

side_plank.name: Side plank from bent knees
side_plank.cue: Place the elbow below the shoulder and lift hips from bent knees while breathing. Switch sides halfway through each set; stop before the trunk rolls or sags.

routines.title: Wall Presses and Bottle Curls
routines.purpose: A standing introduction to upper-body strength using a wall and light household weights, with shoulder movement between the pressing and curling work.

routines.title: Chair Stands and Supported Legs
routines.purpose: Start with the everyday sit-to-stand pattern, then work the calves and side hips while holding a fixed support. No floor transfers are required.

routines.title: Rowing and Cycling Cross-Training
routines.purpose: Combine an upper-and-lower-body rowing pattern with seated cycling. Keep both blocks moderate, and use the changeover to reset posture rather than rushing.

routines.title: Band Squat, Press, Pull and Brace
routines.purpose: A whole-body band session covering legs, chest, back and resistance to trunk rotation. The anti-rotation exercise requires a properly rated fixed anchor, not loose furniture.

routines.title: Pulldowns, Face Pulls and Hammer Curls
routines.purpose: Combine a vertical pull with a lighter high-cable upper-back exercise and neutral-grip curls. Treat the face pull as controlled practice, not a heavy lift.

routines.title: Home Band Back and Biceps
routines.purpose: A pulling-focused band session combining a row, a light upper-back opening movement and elbow flexion without needing gym machines.

routines.title: Counter Push and Floor Press
routines.purpose: Pair an elevated bodyweight press with a supported dumbbell row and floor press. The floor limits pressing depth while the row adds a complementary pull.

routines.title: Seated Shoulders and Hammer Curls
routines.purpose: Use back-supported overhead pressing, very light side raises and neutral-grip curls for a short shoulder-and-arm session with controlled loads.

routines.title: Push-Up and Upper-Back Control
routines.purpose: Combine floor pressing with a small-range prone upper-back movement and a braced hold. This session emphasizes body alignment rather than speed.

routines.title: Floor Press, Row and Triceps
routines.purpose: A dumbbell push-and-pull session with lying triceps work. Use separate manageable weights for each movement instead of forcing the same load throughout.

routines.title: Band Press, Row and Shoulder Rotation
routines.purpose: A compact band-only upper-body session balancing forward pressing, rowing and small-range shoulder rotation, with no door anchor required.

routines.title: Machine Press and Cable Row Basics
routines.purpose: Learn supported pressing and seated pulling, then finish with a light cable curl. Have gym staff check the machine adjustments before adding resistance.

routines.title: Pulldown and Supported Back Work
routines.purpose: Explore vertical pulling and chest-supported rowing, with very light reverse flies. Bench support reduces the need to hold a bent-over stance.

routines.title: Incline Press and Supported Shoulders
routines.purpose: A pressing-focused gym session combining incline dumbbells, seated shoulder work and cable pressdowns. Keep all sets controlled and comfortably short of failure.

routines.title: Cable Push-Pull and Side Raises
routines.purpose: Balance a standing cable press with seated cable rowing, then use light dumbbells for shoulder raises. Stable foot placement matters more than load.

routines.title: Bench Press, One-Arm Row and Accessories
routines.purpose: A longer upper-body session using flat-bench dumbbells and unilateral rowing, followed by light rear-shoulder and triceps work with separate rest periods.

routines.title: Mini-Squats, Bridges and Clamshells
routines.purpose: Mix a supported shallow squat with two mat-based hip exercises. Move between standing and the floor slowly and use only a comfortable range.

routines.title: Low Steps and Standing Hip Work
routines.purpose: Practice a supported step-up, a small backward leg lift and slow heel raises. Use an actual fixed low step, never a chair or unstable box.

routines.title: Goblet Squat and Hip-Hinge Basics
routines.purpose: Introduce light loaded squatting and hip hinging, then finish on the mat with bridges. Rehearse both standing patterns without weight before the work sets.

routines.title: Split Squats and Single-Leg Bridges
routines.purpose: Work each leg separately through a supported split squat, a single-leg bridge and a side-lying lift. Use support freely to keep the pelvis steady.

routines.title: Reverse Lunges, Band Steps and Wall Hold
routines.purpose: Combine backward stepping, sideways band work and a short shallow isometric hold. This session changes movement direction without jumps or added dumbbells.

routines.title: Single-Leg Hinges, Steps and Calves
routines.purpose: An all-standing unilateral session with a fixed hand support. Alternate a hip hinge, low step-up and single-leg heel raise without adding external load.

routines.title: Leg Press, Seated Curl and Calves
routines.purpose: A supported-machine introduction for the legs. Learn the seat, pad and safety-stop adjustments with staff before using a light, controlled working load.

routines.title: Dumbbell Hinge and Leg Accessories
routines.purpose: Pair a light hip hinge with seated knee-extension work and a supported cable side lift. Keep the standing cable load very light for balance.

routines.title: Goblet Squats, Loaded Lunges and Curls
routines.purpose: Use a bilateral squat, a light loaded reverse lunge and a seated hamstring curl. Take enough rest to maintain the same controlled technique on both legs.

routines.title: Bench Hip Thrusts and Cable Hinges
routines.purpose: Emphasize hip extension through a bodyweight bench thrust and a low-cable hinge, finishing with seated calves. The hip thrust does not require a barbell.

routines.title: Side Lunges, Leg Press and Band Walks
routines.purpose: Add controlled sideways movement around a supported leg press. Use shallow lateral lunges and short band steps so direction changes stay balanced.

routines.title: Seated Hips, Hamstrings and Supported Hinge
routines.purpose: Combine seated side-hip and hamstring machines with an unloaded single-leg hinge using hand support. Keep the standing movement small while learning it.

routines.title: Conversational Level Walk
routines.purpose: A simple outdoor walking session on an even route near home. The main block is purposeful but conversational, not a race or a requirement to hit a fixed speed.

routines.title: Indoor March, Side Steps and Heel Taps
routines.purpose: A low-impact indoor aerobic session with three straightforward standing patterns. Keep one foot on the floor and reduce pace whenever conversation becomes difficult.

routines.title: Easy Dance and Walking Grapevines
routines.purpose: Use music and simple walking dance patterns for aerobic movement without jumps. The grapevine is optional; ordinary side steps are a useful balance-friendly substitute.

routines.title: Gentle Hill and Level Walking
routines.purpose: Walk a familiar gentle uphill section before a level block. Terrain changes the muscular demand without needing to jog; avoid steep, slippery or isolated routes.

routines.title: Low-Step Intervals and Marching
routines.purpose: Use a secured low platform for short stepping blocks, with easy recovery between sets and a marching finish. The goal is steady aerobic work, not speed or jumping.

routines.title: Careful Stair Blocks and Level Walking
routines.purpose: Combine short handrail-supported stair blocks with level walking. Descend slowly and use an easy walk during rests; stairs are not suitable if balance or knee symptoms interfere.

routines.title: Light Shadowboxing and Side Footwork
routines.purpose: A standing aerobic session alternating gentle punching practice and non-jumping lateral movement. Use easy steps during recovery and keep shoulders relaxed.

routines.title: Comfortable Stationary Cycle
routines.purpose: An uncomplicated seated cycling block at a manageable conversational effort. Ask staff to check the bicycle setup before settling into a smooth pedal rhythm.

routines.title: Steady Rowing Technique Session
routines.purpose: Learn the rowing sequence with a low-resistance, conversational main block. A staff technique check is preferable to adding resistance or chasing a distance target.

routines.title: Level Treadmill Walking
routines.purpose: Practice ordinary walking on a level treadmill with the safety clip attached. Adjust speed to your current ability instead of matching another person's settings.

routines.title: Incline Walking and Seated Cycling
routines.purpose: Share the aerobic session between gentle-incline walking and cycling. Pause safely between machines and start pedaling easily before resuming conversational effort.

routines.title: Treadmill Walk and Rowing Combination
routines.purpose: Move from upright level walking to a controlled rowing block. Begin rowing with a few gentle strokes during the transition before reaching conversational working effort.

routines.title: Chair, Wall and Band Whole Body
routines.purpose: Cover a chair squat, wall press, seated band pull and gentle trunk control in one introductory session. Set up the chair and band before beginning.

routines.title: Supported Squat, Counter Push and Mat Work
routines.purpose: Pair supported standing exercises with a bird dog and glute bridge. This bodyweight combination avoids jumping and does not need dumbbells or a band.

routines.title: Dumbbell Lift, Press, Row and Carry
routines.purpose: Practice lifting from raised blocks, floor pressing, supported rowing and carrying light weights. Clear the carry route and use loads that are easy to set down.

routines.title: Push-Ups, Lunges and Trunk Control
routines.purpose: Combine floor pressing, alternating backward lunges, gentle prone upper-back work and a short plank. Keep each exercise as a separate controlled block, not a timed race.

routines.title: Goblet Squat, Shoulder Press and Suitcase Carry
routines.purpose: Move through a loaded squat, back-supported overhead press, supported row and one-sided carry. The carry challenges steady posture without a heavy load.

routines.title: Step, Band Pull and Whole-Body Stability
routines.purpose: Use a low step and fixed hand support for leg work, add seated band rowing, and finish with controlled opposite-limb movement on the mat.

routines.title: Supported Gym Whole-Body Basics
routines.purpose: Use supported machines for legs, chest and back, then practice a light cable anti-rotation press. Get each station fitted before starting its work sets.

routines.title: Hip Hinge, Incline Press and Carry
routines.purpose: Combine a light dumbbell hip hinge with incline pressing, seated cable rowing and a brief two-handed carry. Adjust resistance separately for each movement.

routines.title: Hip Thrust, Supported Row and Shoulder Machine
routines.purpose: Combine bodyweight bench hip thrusts with chest-supported rowing, machine overhead pressing and cable trunk bracing. Keep the bench secure and all transitions unhurried.

routines.title: Loaded Lunge, Bench Press and Side Brace
routines.purpose: Pair unilateral leg strength with flat-bench dumbbell pressing and vertical pulling, then finish with a short bent-knee side plank on each side.

routines.title: Leg Press, Face Pull and One-Sided Carry
routines.purpose: Combine supported leg pressing with light high-cable pulling, seated shoulder pressing and a balanced suitcase carry. Switch the carry hand midway through each set.

routines.title: Five-Pattern Dumbbell and Cable Session
routines.purpose: A longer whole-body session covering squat, hinge, pull, press and controlled trunk movement. Work station by station with full rests rather than reserving equipment as a circuit.
